title: Smoky Hash Browns
description: A crispy, smoky take on the classic hash brown dish.
instructions: Grate potatoes and place in a colander. Squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, mix together grated potatoes, smoked paprika, and olive oil.
Transfer potato mixture to a lined baking sheet and shape into a flat layer.
Bake for 20 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Flip hash browns and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove from oven, let cool for a few minutes, and serve
